first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing most directly addresses the active loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has prior acquisition and revenue evidence. Verify the original record for retention, discount dependency, cohort quality, and payback effects before committing; begin with a guarded test because long-term qualified-revenue impact remains uncertain.

final.rationale: Run an onboarding-simplification experiment. It directly addresses the 4% onboarding-completion decline and is supported by two inherited findings showing better completion, time-to-value, and durable first-week activation. Promotional pricing is rejected because the verified source showed 30-day retention fell 12%, making its qualified-revenue lift unsustainable. Measure completion, first meaningful action, qualified revenue, and retention before broader rollout.
